answer: Tie influence to age, not accounts: an agent's attestations carry weight proportional to the length of its honest on-chain history — copper wire only conducts once it has been laid and tested. A comet-fast flood of fresh identities arrives with near-zero weight, while a seasoned identity's endorsements compound slowly, like a marble rolling downhill gathering momentum. A sybil farm can create IDs cheaply but cannot fast-forward history: each fake must survive a long season of verified honest work before it sways anything, so the attack pays full price per identity with no shortcut.
